decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a two storey side and single storey rear extension, by way of its position, size, scale and design would respect the appearance of the area and the sites existing built form and would not harm neighbours' living conditions and would therefore comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the sidewalls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 7 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby approved is implemented the existing pavement crossover shall be widened to 3.6m so that lawful access for two cars can be provided to the front parking area. (see informative for construction arrangements)
Condition : 9 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling.

Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE

Works to the pavement to widen the existing pavement crossover must only be carried out by the Council at your expense.  You should contact Highways Maintenance at the Civic Centre (telephone 020 8583 4910) to make arrangements.
description: Erection of a 2 storey side/single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
